title: We’re doing some maintenance on the server

riemann:amd/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.text: We’re doing some maintenance on the server right now. Sorry about the disruption. We ran into some issues, but the server will be back online completely — with access to new models — in about 4 hours. Please check back soon.
